title: Ms. Christmas Comes to Town
description: After receiving a terminal diagnosis, a shopping channel host known as Ms. Christmas embarks on a multi-city excursion to spread holiday cheer before her farewell broadcast.

title: Return to Santa
description: When Santa finds Jake's decades-old Christmas list, he decides to fast-track all the wishes, disrupting Jake's practical life and jeopardizing his reconnection with childhood best friend Julie.

title: Debbie Macomber's Joyful Mrs. Miracle
description: Mrs. Miracle uses Christmas magic to reunite three siblings who must decide who will inherit the family's real estate empire, following their grandmother's passing.

title: Holiday Unplugged
description: When Sally loses years of precious family videos, she convinces her family to go "no tech" for the holidays, enlisting former teacher Damon to help recover the videos in time for Christmas.

title: 'Tis the Season to Be Irish
description: Rose tries to flip a house in Ireland but is blocked by Sean, a handsome local who wants to preserve the historic cottage.

title: My Norwegian Holiday
